# video38 reconstruction report (round 001)

Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline; not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

Observed in the 24 reference samples (0.00 s to 12.60 s): one locked low-angle wide shot with no cuts and cinemascope letterbox bars. A woman in a cream blouse and long white skirt sits on a dirt road left of centre, facing image-right, head bowed. Until about 2.8 s her near hand is at her face; from 3.29 s both arms rest on her knees. Behind her are a weathered white gable-front farmhouse with a rust-roofed porch wing on the left and a lean-to on the right, a dead tree on the left, and sheds on the right. A man in brown trousers and a light-blue short-sleeved shirt enters at the right edge around 1.08 s, very close to the camera, so only his legs are visible. He walks away from the camera into depth on the right side and stops to the right of her feet at about 5.5 to 6.0 s. He shuffles left while turning to face the camera and the woman (shirt front visible by 7.1 s), starts bending forward with his hands on his thighs (8.2 to 9.8 s), lowers into a crouch (10.4 to 11.0 s), and stays crouched with his left hand on the ground and his face toward her until the end.

Geometry: box, sphere and cylinder proxies for the house (main box, gable prism, roof trims, windows, lean-to, porch wing, porch roof, posts, chimney), the ground (grass plane with a dirt-road polygon), the tree, the sheds, bushes, and a distant tree band. Woman: seat box, thigh and shin cylinders (skirt colour, skin ankles), feet, a leaning torso, a bowed head with a hair proxy, and two articulated arms. Man: pelvis, a pitched torso, a head with a hair cap, arms with sleeve, upper arm, forearm and hand, and legs with thigh, shin and shoe. All limbs are hierarchical.

Articulation and timing: the man's feet-centre path is keyed from foot image positions at the sample times (about 0.77 m/s walk). The gait phase comes from the travelled distance, using 2-bone IK legs with stance and swing foot targets. Yaw goes from facing away (walking) to facing left at about 6.0 s and toward camera-left from 7 s. Hip height, hip offset and torso pitch are keyed through the bend and crouch. The arms blend from FK walking swing to IK targets on the thighs and knees, and the left hand then goes to the ground from 10.3 to 10.95 s. The woman's near hand moves from her face to her knees between 2.85 and 3.3 s. Everything is sampled absolutely from time.

Camera: a fixed perspective camera at a height of 0.42 m, with focal length about 1650 px at 720p (vertical FOV about 24.6 deg) and a small upward pitch so the horizon sits about 40 px below centre. The black letterbox bars are geometry attached to the camera.

Inference rather than observation: the motion between samples, the exact gait phase, the depth of every object (estimated from the ground-contact image rows), the man's exact facing during the turn, and the hidden parts of his body while he is cut off by the frame top.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round).

rounds.reason: Fix bend/crouch timing, man yaw, hand contacts, woman arms and ground/house brightness.

Behind her are a weathered white gable-front farmhouse with a rust-roofed porch wing on the left and a lean-to on the right, a dead tree on the left, and sheds on the right. A man in brown trousers and a light-blue short-sleeved shirt enters at the right edge around 1.08 s, very close to the camera, so only his legs are visible. He walks away from the camera into depth on the right side and stops to the right of her feet at about 5.5 to 6.0 s. He shuffles left while turning to face the camera and the woman (shirt front visible by 7.1 s), starts bending forward with his hands on his thighs (8.2 to 9.8 s), lowers into a crouch (10.4 to 11.0 s), and stays crouched with his left hand on the ground and his face toward her until the end.

Geometry: box, sphere and cylinder proxies for the house (main box, gable prism, roof trims, windows, lean-to, porch wing, porch roof, posts, chimney), the ground (grass plane with a dirt-road polygon), the tree, the sheds, bushes, and a distant tree band. Woman: seat box, thigh and shin cylinders (skirt colour, skin ankles), feet, a leaning torso, a bowed head with a hair proxy, and two articulated arms. Man: pelvis, a pitched torso, a head with a hair cap, arms with sleeve, upper arm, forearm and hand, and legs with thigh, shin and shoe. All limbs are hierarchical.

Articulation and timing: the man's feet-centre path is keyed from foot image positions at the sample times (about 0.77 m/s walk). The gait phase comes from the travelled distance, using 2-bone IK legs with stance and swing foot targets. Yaw goes from facing away (walking) to facing left at about 6.0 s and toward camera-left from 7 s. Hip height, hip offset and torso pitch are keyed through the bend and crouch. The arms blend from FK walking swing to IK targets on the thighs and knees, and the left hand then goes to the ground from 10.3 to 10.95 s. The woman's near hand moves from her face to her knees between 2.85 and 3.3 s. Everything is sampled absolutely from time.

Camera: a fixed perspective camera at a height of 0.42 m, with focal length about 1650 px at 720p (vertical FOV about 24.6 deg) and a small upward pitch so the horizon sits about 40 px below centre. The black letterbox bars are geometry attached to the camera.

Inference rather than observation: the motion between samples, the exact gait phase, the depth of every object (estimated from the ground-contact image rows), the man's exact facing during the turn, and the hidden parts of his body while he is cut off by the frame top.

Feedback received: round 001 render with 24 paired comparisons. It confirmed the static camera framing, the letterbox, the house and woman placement, and the man's walk path and foot rows. It showed these problems: the man bent too early (heavily bent by 9.3 s, while the reference is still nearly upright with his hands on his thighs); he faced the camera too early (the reference is near-profile facing left at 7.1 s); the dirt and house walls were too dark; the woman's forearms stuck out past her knees; and only one of his hands reached the ground in the crouch.
